description: This file defines a Java class UpdateStandingInstructionCommandHandler which handles commands to update standing instructions in the system. It implements the NewCommandSourceHandler interface and delegates the update operation to StandingInstructionWritePlatformService.

classes.name: UpdateStandingInstructionCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class that handles update commands for standing instructions, implementing the processCommand method.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the JSON command by invoking the update method on the standingInstructionWritePlatformService.
